## Endpoints

### Auth Flow (2)
- `GET /charm/horizon/common/authentication/providers/AuthStateProviderAction` — Get authentication provider state.
- `POST /i/api/session/refresh` — Refresh the current session.

### Data Read (12)
- `GET /{id}/horizon/common/privacy/providers/CookiesDataProvider` — Get cookie data for privacy settings.
- `GET /{id}/horizon/react/component/{componentId}` — Fetch a specific React component's data.
- `GET /{id}/sodar` — Retrieve data from Sodar.
- `GET /i/api/account/dataSharing/v1/optOut` — Check data sharing opt-out status.
- `GET /i/api/cookies/v2/` — Read cookie data for session management.
- `GET /i/api/trips/trip/v1/allUpcomingSimplifiedTrips` — Get a list of upcoming trips.
- `GET /i/api/trips/user/v1/currentUser` — Retrieve current user's profile.
- `GET /i/api/trips/wishlist/v1/summaries` — Fetch summaries of wishlist items.
- `GET /mvm/p13n/flight/destinations` — Retrieve popular flight destinations.
- `GET /notifications` — Get notifications
- `GET /s/horizon/common/personalization/Usp` — Get user personalization settings.
- `GET /s/run/fpc/context` — Get first-party context data.

### Data Write (4)
- `POST /i/api/dynamicfrontdoor/v1/trendingDestinations/{trendingDestinationId}` — Update trending destination data.
- `POST /s/horizon/flights/common/GetFlightSearchHistoryAction` — Save flight search history.
- `POST /s/run/{runId}` — Submit data to a specific run.
- `POST /s/vestigo/measure` — Send performance measurement data.

### Search (1)
- `POST /a/api/smarty/nearby` — Find nearby locations using Smarty.

### Core API (2)
- `GET /i/api/{apiId}/v1/{v1Id}` — Access a core Kayak API endpoint.
- `POST /i/api/dynamicfrontdoor/v1/{v1Id}` — Access a dynamic front door API endpoint.

```typescript
async function getCurrentUserProfile() {
  try {

    console.log("User Profile:", userProfile);
    return userProfile;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to fetch user profile:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

```typescript
    console.log("Flight search saved:", response);
    return response;
  } catch (error) {
    console.error("Failed to save flight search:", error);
    return null;
  }
}
```

## About This Skill

This skill provides access to Kayak De's internal API — the hidden endpoints that power their web/mobile app.
These are NOT official public APIs. They were captured by observing network traffic while using the site.

**Important:**
- Auth tokens in `auth.json` may expire — re-capture if you get 401 errors
- Internal APIs can change without notice — endpoints may break
- Rate limits are unknown — be conservative with request frequency

## When to Use This Skill

Use this skill when you need to:
- Access Kayak De data without official API access
- Automate actions on www.kayak.de (faster than browser automation)
- Call the same endpoints the Kayak De frontend uses
